the All Sample Mean Normalizer (ASMN) procedure is the most consistent and reliable normalization procedure for large-scale population studies using the Illumina HumanMethylation 450 BeadChip array.

the All Sample Mean Normalisation (ASMN) procedure performs well in reducing technical variation and batch effects and is a suitable normalization procedure to implement in large epidemiologic studies.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed ASMN normalization method is the preferred normalization method to use for the Illumina 450k methylation data.
the ASMN normalization method is recommended for use in population-based 450k methylation data.
the ASMN normalization is an effective and robust method for reducing batch effects and technical variation in 450K data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
normalization procedures should be selected carefully and evaluated for the specific study context.

there is no perfect normalization procedure and that the choice of normalization should be based on a combination of the study design, the data analysis plan, and the computational resources available to the researcher.

normalization procedures for the 450K platform can have a substantial effect on the downstream analysis, and therefore, it is critical that investigators carefully consider the normalization procedure they use for their data.
